description: Parking Lot Entrances and Exits is a dataset listed in City of Austin open data portal (datahub.austintexas.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Austin. Entrances and exits to surface and garage parking lots in the downtown area of Austin, TX. The data is also available as an Esri File Geodatabase, here: This product is for informational purposes and may not have been prepared for or be suitable for legal, engineering, or surveying purposes. Coverage: Austin. The portal files it under the category Transportation and Mobility. Its tags are transit, atx, austin, mobility, parking. The table has 21 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Austin, Texas - data.austintexas.gov. The portal shows 2016-12-12 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datahub-austintexas-gov-portal.
